extensions.name: Project System
extensions.description: Manage complex projects, break them down into tasks, set deadlines, and track progress.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Auto Read Reminders
extensions.description: Automatically reads out reminders when navigating dates with arrows.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Date Calculator
extensions.description: Calculates the number of days between the currently selected date and today.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Developer News
extensions.description: Stay updated with the latest news and announcements from the developer team.
extensions.author: Novarealm

extensions.name: Developer Toolkit
extensions.description: Heavy-duty developer tools: REPL Console, Event Sniffer, Live Log Viewer, Extension Inspector & Hot-Reloader, HRK Packer.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: My Diary
extensions.description: Secure diary and notes extension with mood tracking.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Ghost Taskbar Cleaner
extensions.description: Cleans up ghost icons left behind in the Windows System Tray.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Key Notifier
extensions.description: Plays sounds when CapsLock or NumLock state changes.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Lumina
extensions.description: Birthday reminders for friends, family and yourself. Lumina lights up your calendar with the moments that matter most.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Markdown Reader
extensions.description: Open, read, and navigate Markdown (.md) files with full screen reader accessibility.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Quotes
extensions.description: Fetches and reads random quotes from Novarealm API.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Smart Launcher
extensions.description: Create customizable URL/command selectors with their own hotkeys. Replaces Mail Selector AHK.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Wikipedia Reader
extensions.description: Search and read Wikipedia articles directly from Hariku
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Window Teleporter
extensions.description: Teleport to virtual desktops and pin windows for instant Alt-Tab ninja navigation.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Routines
extensions.description: iOS-Shortcuts-style automation: run a chain of actions automatically when conditions are met (time, battery, idle, focused app, clipboard, network) — or on demand with Run Now. Manage them from the Routines window.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Filter
extensions.description: Search and filter your reminders and events across all dates. Find anything instantly with keyword search.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Google Calendar Reader
extensions.description: Read your Google Calendar events inside Hariku. One-way sync: reads from Google, edits stay local.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Quick Expand
extensions.description: Auto-expand custom typed abbreviations (like 'my_email') into full text templates globally across Windows.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Weather
extensions.description: Hear the current weather and a 7-day forecast. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a city you choose in Preferences, Weather. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Morning Briefing
extensions.description: Hear a short spoken briefing: a greeting, today's date, today's reminders and news from other extensions such as the weather. Optionally plays the first time Hariku starts each day.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Finance
extensions.description: Track income and expenses offline: balance and summaries, history by month and category, monthly budgets with spoken warnings, recurring transactions, and an optional daily reminder. Understands amounts like 20.000, 20rb or 1,5jt.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: World Clock
extensions.description: Hear the current time in cities around the world. Press the World Clock hotkey to speak every zone, or open the window to browse them. Manage your cities in Preferences.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Hariku Account Manager
extensions.description: Sign in with your InfiArtt account (infiartt.com). Provides identity for extensions with online features.
extensions.author: Hariku Core Team

extensions.name: Flight Radar
extensions.description: Hear the aircraft flying near your city: the nearest few on a hotkey, a list of everything in range, optional announcements when one passes overhead or reports an emergency, and a shortcut that opens LiveATC's page for the nearby airport in your browser. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place, city, street address or exact coordinates you choose in Preferences, Flight Radar; your exact location stays on your computer. Aircraft data by adsb.fi and adsb.lol, flight routes by adsbdb.com, address search by OpenStreetMap Nominatim (no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Clipboard History
extensions.description: Keeps a list of the text you copy, so you can find, pin and copy it again. Press V for the history and Shift+V to hear the last copied text. Copies from password managers are never recorded, and the history stays in memory unless you choose to remember it.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Sound Themes
extensions.description: Change the sounds Hariku plays, like a visual theme for your ears. Make themes from your own WAV files, switch between them in Preferences, Sound Themes, or with Shift+S, and import or export them as ZIP files. Hariku 1 sound themes can be imported too. Hariku starts with your theme's start sound.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Earthquakes & Tsunami
extensions.description: Hear BMKG's latest earthquake, browse recent earthquakes in Indonesia (and optionally strong ones worldwide from USGS), and get spoken alerts for earthquakes BMKG says have tsunami potential, and optionally for earthquakes near you or felt in your region. Hariku is not an official warning system: always follow BMKG and your local authorities. Earthquake data by BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika) and USGS (no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Sea Conditions
extensions.description: Hear the waves, swell, sea temperature and the tide (rising or falling, the next high and low tide) for a beach or port, and see the next days and tides. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a beach or port you choose in Preferences, Sea Conditions. Sea data by Open-Meteo.com (no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Air Quality
extensions.description: Hear the air quality index, fine particles (PM2.5 and PM10) and the UV index where you are, with a short tip for the category, and see the next hours and days. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a city you choose in Preferences, Air Quality. Air quality data by Open-Meteo.com (CAMS; no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Space
extensions.description: Where is the ISS right now, upcoming rocket launches with a reminder, and today's sunrise, sunset and moon phase. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a city you choose in Preferences, Space; your location never leaves your computer. ISS position: wheretheiss.at. Launch data: The Space Devs Launch Library 2. Sun and Moon are calculated offline.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Cockpit
extensions.description: Pilot vibes: hear the aviation weather (METAR and TAF) of your favourite airports decoded into plain sentences with Q, open them all with Shift+Q, and turn on Captain mode to get the airport weather in your Morning Briefing and evening summary, be called Captain, get a cockpit greeting when Hariku starts and a Cockpit sound theme. Without favourites it uses the airport nearest to your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place you choose. Aviation weather by the NOAA Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov, no account or key needed). For information only, not for flight planning.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Edge Voices
extensions.description: Adds the Microsoft Edge online neural voices, including the Indonesian voices Ardi and Gadis, to Hariku Voice. Choose them in Preferences, Hariku Voice. The text being read is sent to Microsoft's online speech service, which is meant for the Edge browser and may stop working at any time; Hariku then uses your fallback voice.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Piper Voices
extensions.description: Adds Piper neural voices to Hariku Voice. They speak on this computer, without the internet, and include an Indonesian voice. Download the voices you want in Preferences, Piper Voices; Hariku then also downloads the Piper program once, from GitHub. Each voice shows its size, quality and license before you download it.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Sleep Pattern
extensions.description: Estimates when you slept from when you used the computer, like a phone's sleep tracker: hear last night's sleep, see your sleep history and averages, and find out when you stayed up late. Hariku records only whether the keyboard or mouse was used in each minute, never what you typed or which apps you used, and nothing leaves your computer. An estimate, not a medical measurement.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Voice Control
extensions.description: Talk to Aruna, Hariku's command bar (Ctrl+Alt+Backspace): "latest earthquake", "what time is it", or "remind me to take medicine tomorrow at 8", in Indonesian or English. Speech is recognised on this computer by whisper.cpp and is never saved or sent anywhere. Download the program and a speech model in Preferences, Voice Control; each shows its size before you download it. Optionally, say a wake phrase such as "Hey Aruna" to open Aruna listening without a key (off until you turn it on; it listens on this computer only). A headset is recommended.
extensions.author: Rafli
